effectSummary.ko: 최대 HP 35% 보호막을 4초 유지하며 마지막으로 시전한 화염·냉기·번개 속성을 기억합니다. 이 보호막의 첫 실제 흡수에만 반응합니다. 화염은 3m 안 최대 5명에게 3초간 총 D60% 화상, 냉기는 1초 속박, 번개는 마나 8 회복을 줍니다. 기억한 속성이 없으면 추가 반응이 없습니다.
effectSummary.en: Hold a 35% maximum-HP shield for 4s and remember the last cast fire, cold or lightning element. React only on this shield's first actual absorption: fire burns up to 5 enemies within 3m for D60% over 3s, cold roots them for 1s, and lightning restores 8 mana. No remembered element grants no extra reaction.

prompt: Edit this HELLSCRIPT Elemental Shield skill icon. Preserve the same painterly dark fantasy iron structure and three red fire, icy blue and violet-gold lightning facets. Fix the clipped lightning entering at the upper right: show the ENTIRE lightning stroke and every tip within the image. Shrink and recompose the complete shield and lightning to fit within the central 76% of the square, with generous clean transparent margins on ALL FOUR sides. No cut off shapes, no border, no text. Keep the three facets bold and readable at 64x64. Deliver a transparent PNG with preserved native RGBA alpha, fully transparent surrounding and internal empty space, no scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard, floor, frame, or unwanted shadow. Preserve transparency; do not paint a background.

notes.ko: 세 속성이 구분되고 번개의 끝까지 화면 안에 들어옵니다. 수정 원본의 투명 여백과 축소 실루엣을 확인했습니다.
notes.en: Three distinct facets and the complete lightning tip fit within the image. Reviewed transparent margins and the reduced silhouette of the edited original.

reuseReason: Existing GlobalHUD icons are 256px line symbols with UI plates, unsuitable as these 1024px painterly masters.

attempts.purpose: Identity revision; repaired clipped lightning with native transparent edit

visualConcept: Three remembered elemental facets reacting to one shield absorption
